_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and, being the wider of the two (D7), sizes the one sensor — which is also the audience interaction.ambient fans out to. The pre-merge aggroRadius 1.0 stayed as authored but no longer governs anything: under D21 leaving talk range now ENDS a conversation, and 1.0 leaves less standing room than the two bodies take up (L26). experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Strong at the settlement gate. ⚑ QUESTS (plan-quests.md C4): the MILITIA leg of D9's branch — `wolves-on-the-road` carry_word → told_militia, rewarding Taunt (until now a RallyDrummer-only drop) + 400 XP. The Shaman carries the other leg, to a different stage with a different reward, and no code knows there is a choice. The existing Strong@L3 teaching is untouched: the turn-in row navigates back to root so it stays reachable.
name: CityGuard

lines: Village business? Speak plainly, I've a gate to hold.

options.text: The wolves on the west road. Eight of them are dealt with.

grants.line: Eight. Written down, and the commander will have it before nightfall. We don't thank people — we pay them.
Here. A beast that's looking at you isn't looking at the man behind you. Learn to make it look.
Stand up straight. You've done more for that road than the last three patrols.

lines: Sorry, can't let you in, the Orcs are too close.
But maybe you can help out at the front in the south?

grants.line: Wolves at the village? I will let the commander know. Let me teach you something for your trouble.
